assumptions.choice: Use typical price (High+Low+Close)/3 as the per-bar price input to the session VWAP
assumptions.reason: Spec names 'session VWAP' but does not state which price component to weight by volume; typical price is the standard VWAP convention.

assumptions.choice: The 'prior bar' threshold check compares slope(-1) against threshold(-1) (i.e. 2*slope_std computed at the same prior bar), not the current bar's threshold
assumptions.reason: Literal reading of 'slope was below -threshold on the prior bar' evaluates both slope and its threshold at that same past bar, since threshold is itself a rolling, time-varying quantity.

assumptions.choice: The 20-bar slope lookback (VWAP - VWAP(-20)) is not reset or blanked at session/day boundaries; it always compares to the value 20 bars earlier even if that spans two trading days
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly states only the VWAP's cumulative PV/V reset each day; the slope difference is defined purely as a 20-bar offset with no stated day-boundary exception.

assumptions.choice: The protective stop order's size is explicitly set to match the entry order's executed size rather than relying on the default sizer
assumptions.reason: Ensures the stop-loss fully closes the exact position that was opened, as required by 'protective stop-loss' guarding that specific position.

assumptions.choice: Implemented via a native backtrader Stop order (bt.Order.Stop) submitted immediately after entry fill at entry_price*(1 -/+ StopLossPercent), rather than manual price-checking logic in next()
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly allows either 'stop orders or manual stop logic'; a native stop order is the more literal and precise implementation of a stop-loss.
